name: Agenda-Led Workshop or Interview
description: Map a facilitated session to agenda items, contributions, decisions, and unresolved areas.

sections.title: Agenda Coverage
sections.instruction: List agenda items covered, skipped, or deferred.

sections.title: Question and Response Map
sections.instruction: Capture major questions and the responses or contributions offered.
sections.item_format:
| Question or Topic | Response or Contribution |
| --- | --- |

sections.title: Themes and Ideas
sections.instruction: Summarize recurring themes, requirements, and ideas.

sections.title: Convergence and Divergence
sections.instruction: Identify points of agreement, disagreement, minority views, explicit votes, or conflicts without forcing consensus.

sections.title: Decisions and Open Questions
sections.instruction: List decisions, parking-lot items, and unresolved questions.

sections.title: Actions and Confirmations
sections.instruction: List actions, owners, dates, and items requiring confirmation.
